messages.author: 2156766bad831d82
messages.subject: Build Index has a long time
parts:
Hi, I have started a build index at June, 04@12:00PM. To day is June, 06@9:00AM. Elapsed 45 hours and it not finished yet. It is running in a Debian Testing box in a Dell Inspiron Core i7 with 8 GB of RAM. I was building index from Eucalyptus grandis genome (~700 MB). This time is ok or something have occurred? I was running R inside Emacs. Have you an estimated time to do so?

Thank you very much!

Marcelo

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Build Index has a long time
parts:
Hi Marcelo,

I'm not sure which version of Rsubread that you're using. If it is a recent version, the default setting is to build a full index, and 8GB of memory (and I guess that the available memory size is even smaller if other programs are running) is a little inadequate to that end. 

If you're building a full index, you can try to specify "gappedIndex=TRUE" to the index builder; it will substantially reduce memory use for building the index and for mapping the reads.

Cheers,
Yang
